sample.source: Saved snapshot and fixed-window OpenDota requery

scoring.pooledWinPoints: 5 × lower 95% Wilson bound as a fraction
scoring.carryBenchmark: Average of best modeled DPS across three role gold budgets, level 12, 10 target armor, up to two items. Scaled against highest mean in the carry candidate list.
scoring.midBenchmark: One strongest supported spell at level 12 and 25% target magic resistance, scaled against highest mapped cast among mid candidates. Missing cases use the mapped mid median, reported separately.
scoring.eligibility: Candidate positions are suggested from the hero kit and conventional role fit. Observed positions are counted separately.

rankings.name: Anti-Mage
rankings.mechanic: Blink accesses targets and camps while Mana Break scales with enemy mana; wave clear usually comes from a purchased item.

rankings.name: Terrorblade
rankings.mechanic: Conjure Image farms separately and Metamorphosis gives a ranged damage window; the window and shared unit management constrain execution.

rankings.name: Phantom Lancer
rankings.mechanic: Juxtapose creates extra attacking units, Doppelganger can dodge or reposition, and single-target attacks from copies scale beyond the hero-only benchmark.

rankings.name: Templar Assassin
rankings.mechanic: Psi Blades spill attacks onto units behind the target, Meld adds armor reduction, and Refraction protects against discrete damage instances.

rankings.name: Gyrocopter
rankings.mechanic: Flak Cannon applies attacks across nearby targets, and Homing Missile adds delayed control. Flak count and combat area determine output.

rankings.name: Juggernaut
rankings.mechanic: Blade Dance adds crits, Blade Fury can clear waves, and Omnislash adds attacks. Basic attacks during Blade Fury require Scepter in 7.42.

rankings.name: Morphling
rankings.mechanic: Attribute Shift changes offensive and defensive stats, and Waveform gives reach or escape. Most farm outside Waveform comes from attacks.

rankings.name: Naga Siren
rankings.mechanic: Mirror Image splits farm and creates attack copies; Song can reset a fight but does not guarantee the next damaging window.

rankings.name: Sven
rankings.mechanic: Great Cleave clears waves and clusters, God's Strength adds a burst window, and Storm Hammer helps Sven make contact.

rankings.name: Nature's Prophet
rankings.mechanic: Teleportation connects farm and push across lanes, and treants add separately controlled pressure; neither counts as personal attack DPS.

rankings.name: Wraith King
rankings.mechanic: Bone Guard skeletons farm or push, Mortal Strike adds a crit, and Reincarnation gives a second life when ready and paid for.

rankings.name: Shadow Fiend
rankings.mechanic: Shadowrazes clear waves and armor reduction supports physical damage; front-loaded spells and attacks require positioning.

rankings.name: Kez
rankings.mechanic: Katana and sai stances have different attack cadence, and Grappling Claw enables a targeted approach; stance sequencing matters.

rankings.name: Phantom Assassin
rankings.mechanic: Coup de Grace supplies critical attack spikes and Phantom Strike bridges distance. Farming typically accelerates after a purchased cleave item.

rankings.name: Monkey King
rankings.mechanic: Jingu Mastery rewards committing hits, Tree Dance offers access, and Wukong's Command supplies extra attacks inside a fixed area.

rankings.name: Medusa
rankings.mechanic: Split Shot converts sustained attacks into multi-target pressure, and Mana Shield buys durability; Medusa has limited target pursuit.

rankings.name: Lifestealer
rankings.mechanic: Feast rewards sustained contact, and Rage helps him stay on a target through eligible disables; farming has limited native area damage.

rankings.name: Luna
rankings.mechanic: Moon Glaives make farm and pressure scale across nearby units; short-ranged attacks still depend on spacing.

rankings.name: Troll Warlord
rankings.mechanic: Fervor rewards staying on the same unit, while Whirling Axes and attack-form switching help contact. Changing targets interrupts the Fervor payoff.

rankings.name: Drow Ranger
rankings.mechanic: Multishot hits waves and Marksmanship rewards spacing; the client lists a 300-unit disable radius.

rankings.name: Lina
rankings.mechanic: Dragon Slave clears waves, Fiery Soul stacks movement speed, and delayed Light Strike Array is easier to land with setup.

rankings.name: Puck
rankings.mechanic: Illusory Orb and Waning Rift clear and reposition; Dream Coil restrains a cluster, and Phase Shift helps survive counterplay.

rankings.name: Queen of Pain
rankings.mechanic: Scream of Pain clears nearby units and Blink reaches side lanes; Sonic Wave adds burst, with limited prolonged control.

rankings.name: Primal Beast
rankings.mechanic: Trample and Onslaught clear and reach fights; Pulverize adds focused control that depends on completing its channel.

rankings.name: Pangolier
rankings.mechanic: Swashbuckle clears and carries 60% Item Potency. Rolling Thunder gives mobile repeated stuns that depend on terrain and approach angle.

rankings.name: Storm Spirit
rankings.mechanic: Static Remnant clears waves, Electric Vortex catches a target, and Ball Lightning brings gap close at a mana cost.

rankings.name: Kunkka
rankings.mechanic: Tidebringer clears and pressures through waves; X Marks the Spot helps time Torrent or Ghostship.

rankings.name: Ember Spirit
rankings.mechanic: Sleight of Fist and Flame Guard clear and pressure, while Fire Remnant plus Searing Chains creates rotation reach.

rankings.name: Zeus
rankings.mechanic: Arc Lightning clears repeated waves and Thundergod's Wrath contributes globally; early native hard lockdown is limited.

rankings.name: Void Spirit
rankings.mechanic: Resonant Pulse and Dissimilate clear nearby units, while Astral Step and Aether Remnant enable catches and repositioning.

rankings.name: Invoker
rankings.mechanic: Invoker combines Tornado and Cold Snap for rotations, with wave clearing and execution varying by orb investment and spell order.

rankings.name: Earth Spirit
rankings.mechanic: Rolling Boulder gives reach and Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash can stop follow-up; spell geometry and Remnants condition reliability.

rankings.name: Tiny
rankings.mechanic: Avalanche and Toss burst units in an area, while Toss offers displacement; reliable starts at range often depend on Blink.

rankings.name: Timbersaw
rankings.mechanic: Whirling Death and Chakram clear waves; Timber Chain gives terrain-dependent movement and Reactive Armor improves persistence under attacks.

rankings.name: Death Prophet
rankings.mechanic: Crypt Swarm clears waves, Silence controls an area, and Exorcism converts objective windows when ready.

rankings.name: Pugna
rankings.mechanic: Nether Blast clears quickly and hits buildings; Decrepify and Life Drain give powerful but situational fight options.

rankings.name: Templar Assassin
rankings.mechanic: Psi Blades clears through a wave, Refraction protects discrete hits, and traps give scouting and a delayed slow.

rankings.name: Dragon Knight
rankings.mechanic: Breathe Fire clears in a line, Dragon Tail is point-target control, and Elder Dragon Form adds building pressure.

rankings.name: Shadow Fiend
rankings.mechanic: Shadowraze clears waves and stacks debuffs, but spacing several casts and setting up Requiem matter for fight conversion.

rankings.name: Leshrac
rankings.mechanic: Split Earth provides delayed control; Pulse Nova clears waves and Diabolic Edict hits buildings, with resource and proximity costs.

rankings.name: Centaur Warrunner
rankings.mechanic: Maxed Hoof Stomp stuns 2.2s in a 325 radius every 12s. Strength and Retaliate help hold melee ground. Stampede gives global team movement for 3.5–4.5s.

rankings.name: Tidehunter
rankings.mechanic: Ravage provides a 1,250-radius area stun with a 150/145/140s cooldown. Kraken Shell blocks attack damage and can strong-dispel, while Anchor Smash lowers enemy attacks.

rankings.name: Magnus
rankings.mechanic: Reverse Polarity groups and stuns, Skewer displaces, and Empower lets a melee ally cleave waves and farm. Reliable fog entry often needs Blink.

rankings.name: Dark Seer
rankings.mechanic: Maxed Vacuum displaces in a 550 radius every 26s in 7.42. Ion Shell pushes, Surge enables entry or escape, and Wall replicas have 60% Item Potency.

rankings.name: Dragon Knight
rankings.mechanic: Dragon Tail gives a primary-target stun with nearby splash control. Dragon Blood supplies armor and regeneration, Breathe Fire lowers enemy attack damage, and Dragon Form pressures towers.

rankings.name: Dawnbreaker
rankings.mechanic: Solar Guardian joins a distant ally with healing and a landing stun. Luminosity supports sustain and Starbreaker sweeps waves; interrupting her windup limits the save.

rankings.name: Underlord
rankings.mechanic: Pit of Malice constrains a zone, Firestorm clears waves, Atrophy reduces enemy base attack damage, and Fiend's Gate enables team repositioning.

rankings.name: Sand King
rankings.mechanic: Burrowstrike combines repositioning with a line stun. Caustic Finale and Sand Storm clear waves, though detection limits Sand Storm protection.

rankings.name: Mars
rankings.mechanic: Arena constrains a fight and blocks eligible ranged attacks. Spear can pin against terrain, Bulwark mitigates frontal attacks, and Rebuke clears waves.

rankings.name: Slardar
rankings.mechanic: Sprint and area Crush give entry and control. Bash rewards uninterrupted attacks. Corrosive Haze reduces target armor and gives follow-up vision.

rankings.name: Primal Beast
rankings.mechanic: Onslaught covers ground and knocks targets back. Pulverize repeatedly controls a target. Trample is mobile area wave clear, while enemy disables interrupt follow-through.

rankings.name: Pangolier
rankings.mechanic: Rolling Thunder chains stuns and disrupts clustered fights. Shield Crash gives survivability, and Swashbuckle supplies wave clear and movement. Narrow routes and interruptions matter.

rankings.name: Kunkka
rankings.mechanic: X sets up Torrent or Ghostship and can move an ally back to its return location. Ship's rum delays damage, and Tidebringer clears clustered waves.

rankings.name: Wraith King
rankings.mechanic: Wraithfire Blast stuns, skeletons push lanes, and Reincarnation extends frontlining when available. Position 3 leaves less room for a greedy item path.

rankings.name: Abaddon
rankings.mechanic: Aphotic Shield absorbs damage and strong-dispels an ally on cast. Mist Coil heals, and Borrowed Time gives durability. Native hard entry and lane clear are limited.

rankings.name: Brewmaster
rankings.mechanic: Primal Split replaces direct exposure with controllable bodies and adds stun or Cyclone options. Those jobs require split uptime and good unit control.

rankings.name: Enigma
rankings.mechanic: Black Hole is an area disable that pierces debuff immunity. Eidolons push waves and buildings. Channel interruptions and ultimate downtime leave gaps.

rankings.name: Visage
rankings.mechanic: Two Familiars add attacks, Stone Form stuns and tower pressure. Grave Chill boosts nearby Familiars and Cloak protects nearby units. This specialist pick depends on unit control.

rankings.name: Night Stalker
rankings.mechanic: Crippling Fear silences nearby casters. Dark Ascension gives night, movement and scouting access for picks. His frontlining and reach depend on the night cycle and opponents.

rankings.name: Axe
rankings.mechanic: Maxed Berserker's Call is a 3s taunt in a 315 radius on a 12s cooldown and pierces debuff immunity. Blink solves melee entry; in 7.42, missed attacks advance Counter Helix.

rankings.name: Tusk
rankings.mechanic: Snowball can bring allies in or protect them briefly; Ice Shards blocks paths and Walrus Punch interrupts at melee range.

rankings.name: Disruptor
rankings.mechanic: Glimpse punishes recent repositioning; Kinetic Field and Static Storm hold and silence an area in combination.

rankings.name: Vengeful Spirit
rankings.mechanic: Magic Missile starts a catch; Nether Swap repositions an ally or enemy and Wave of Terror supports physical follow-up.

rankings.name: Marci
rankings.mechanic: Rebound jumps via an ally, then Dispose repositions targets; her early impact depends on an ally anchor and follow-up.

rankings.name: Earth Spirit
rankings.mechanic: Rolling Boulder closes distance and stuns, with greater reach through a Stone Remnant; remnant management governs follow-up control.

rankings.name: Clockwerk
rankings.mechanic: Hookshot extends initiation range, Power Cogs separates targets, and Rocket Flare checks distant areas.

rankings.name: Spirit Breaker
rankings.mechanic: Charge of Darkness reaches visible units across the map and Nether Strike extends the catch; allies need time to follow.

rankings.name: Pudge
rankings.mechanic: Meat Hook pulls a target, including an ally in reach, and Dismember holds a target at melee range.

rankings.name: Enchantress
rankings.mechanic: Enchant turns an available neutral creep into lane or rotation utility; additional control depends on the creep taken.

rankings.name: Pugna
rankings.mechanic: Nether Blast pressures waves and towers; Decrepify changes physical and magical exposure, and Nether Ward punishes spell casts.

rankings.name: Mirana
rankings.mechanic: Sacred Arrow reaches far and rewards allied setup; Leap and Moonlight Shadow provide mobility and team movement.

rankings.name: Venomancer
rankings.mechanic: Plague Wards secure routes and pressure waves on low gold; Gale and Poison Sting slow rather than instantly lock targets.

rankings.name: Shadow Demon
rankings.mechanic: Disruption banishes an ally or sets up an enemy; Demonic Purge slows and removes enemy buffs.

rankings.name: Nyx Assassin
rankings.mechanic: Vendetta enables roams, Impale stuns in a line, and Spiked Carapace punishes predictable incoming damage.

rankings.name: Techies
rankings.mechanic: Sticky Bomb supplies ranged lane pressure, Blast Off! punishes clustered targets, and Proximity Mines secure routes.

rankings.name: Snapfire
rankings.mechanic: Scatterblast wins close trades, Firesnap Cookie jumps an ally into a stun, and Mortimer Kisses contributes from range.

rankings.name: Earthshaker
rankings.mechanic: Fissure reaches across terrain and blocks retreat; Echo Slam punishes clustered fights, with Blink important for close-range delivery.

rankings.name: Grimstroke
rankings.mechanic: Ink Swell accelerates an allied initiator into a stun, Stroke covers waves, and Soulbind punishes enemies who stay close.

rankings.name: Phoenix
rankings.mechanic: Icarus Dive brings slows across an area, Sun Ray can heal allies, and Supernova forces enemy attention.

rankings.name: Tiny
rankings.mechanic: Avalanche interrupts in an area, and Toss can deliver or reposition a nearby unit; Blink improves target selection and access.

rankings.name: Vengeful Spirit
rankings.mechanic: Nether Swap can extract a threatened ally or displace an enemy; Magic Missile and Wave of Terror deliver follow-up.

rankings.name: Warlock
rankings.mechanic: Shadow Word sustains the lane; Fatal Bonds shares damage and Chaotic Offering interrupts an area from range on a long cooldown.

rankings.name: Chen
rankings.mechanic: Hand of God supplies global team sustain, while Holy Persuasion grants neutral-creep pressure and creep-dependent control.

rankings.name: Treant Protector
rankings.mechanic: Living Armor can protect at a distance, and Overgrowth restrains clustered enemies; his wave defense depends on reaching a suitable cast angle.

rankings.name: Oracle
rankings.mechanic: False Promise delays damage and applies a strong dispel; Fortune’s End roots, and Fate’s Edict changes an ally’s magic exposure.

rankings.name: Shadow Demon
rankings.mechanic: Disruption removes a threatened ally from the fight briefly; Demonic Purge pressures buffs and Shadow Poison pushes from range.

rankings.name: Dazzle
rankings.mechanic: Shallow Grave delays an ally’s death and Shadow Wave heals; Axe’s Culling Blade can still kill through Grave.

rankings.name: Lich
rankings.mechanic: Frost Shield reduces incoming attack damage, Frost Blast trades in lane, and Sinister Gaze can interrupt an attacker.

rankings.name: Abaddon
rankings.mechanic: Aphotic Shield strong dispels and absorbs damage; Mist Coil sustains an ally while Borrowed Time improves Abaddon’s own survival.

rankings.name: Bane
rankings.mechanic: Nightmare can protect an ally briefly and Fiend’s Grip holds a dangerous target while channeled; few tools clear a wave.

rankings.name: Ringmaster
rankings.mechanic: Escape Act puts an ally into a protective box, while Tame the Beasts supplies lane pressure and delayed fear.

rankings.name: Pugna
rankings.mechanic: Nether Blast clears waves and pressures structures; Decrepify can protect against attacks but changes magic vulnerability.

rankings.name: Undying
rankings.mechanic: Decay wins early strength trades, Soul Rip can heal an ally, and Tombstone forces attention or restricts an area.

rankings.name: Winter Wyvern
rankings.mechanic: Cold Embrace blocks physical damage but holds the ally in place; Winter’s Curse controls clustered enemies and Splinter Blast clears waves.

rankings.name: Shadow Shaman
rankings.mechanic: Hex and channeled Shackles chain lockdown; Mass Serpent Ward creates tower pressure and Ether Shock clears waves.

rankings.name: Grimstroke
rankings.mechanic: Stroke of Fate defends waves and Ink Swell supports an allied jump; Soulbind disrupts enemy movement and targeting.

rankings.name: Witch Doctor
rankings.mechanic: Voodoo Restoration sustains nearby allies, Paralyzing Cask bounces between targets, and Death Ward requires a protected channel.

rankings.name: Omniknight
rankings.mechanic: Purification heals an ally and damages nearby enemies; Guardian Angel protects against physical damage.

rankings.name: Phoenix
rankings.mechanic: Sun Ray can heal allies, and Supernova can turn an area fight when the team can protect the egg.

rankings.name: Jakiro
rankings.mechanic: Dual Breath pressures lanes and waves, Ice Path zones approaches, and Liquid Fire pressures structures; no direct ally save.
